definitions: A platform or service that provides a unified API for accessing various large language models (LLMs) and other AI models from different providers.
A company or entity that operates the OpenRouter platform, facilitating access to a wide range of AI models.
examples: Developers often use OpenRouter to integrate multiple AI models into their applications.
The latest update from OpenRouter includes support for several new models.
Choosing OpenRouter simplifies the process of switching between different LLMs.
